name: power-platform-solution-deployment-validation
title: Deploy Power Platform Solutions with Pre-Deployment Validation
shortDescription: Automate Power Platform solution deployment between environments with configurable validation checks before import.
longDescription: Automate the export, validation and deployment of an unmanaged Power Platform solution between environments.

The GitHub Actions workflow uses Power Platform CLI and PowerShell to export the solution, unpack it, validate components against configurable naming conventions, and import it into the target environment only when validation succeeds.
